build: make -C runtime/c/backends/vulkan OUT=/tmp/doe-c-vulkan all check; strict C11 -O2, 15 host suites, C++ public headers,80 ABI records/1418 assertions.
implementation: Exact12-byte GPU copy, requested/device-limit guard, barrier, prepared target bind and native indirect dispatch on the existing command/descriptor/retirement owners. Caller validator release cannot release retained scratch or pipelines. Removed superseded always-unsupported raw entrypoint.
limitations: No CPU argument substitution or host shader interpreter. Native-boundary host mocks test packets/lifetimes, not GPU values.
Axis-only guard does not admit newer product-sensitive workgroup/global-invocation-index builtins; current compiler rejects them.
Indexed/indirect graphics remain unsupported. Failed scratch requires a fresh validator; unknown submissions retain native owners.
No physical execution or performance parity claim. Software checks use process-local ICD selection only.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial target descriptor admission occurred after argument copy/guard. Sticky poison prevented submission, but incorrect target emitted partial native work. Final code uses existing prepare_resources before copying and binds prepared target after guard; focused test now verifies zero native operations on invalid target bindings.
Initial spirv-val PATH lookup was absent. Existing pinned explicit executable was used successfully; no installation.

sanitizers: Focused indirect_contract and indirect_lifetime with every backend source -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined; detect_leaks=0. Resource composition additionally instruments resource/backend/labels/frozen shader owner. External ICD and held compiler DSO remain optimized.
scope: Developer typed GPU compute-indirect checks; explicit software ICD only, not independent acceptance or physical qualification.
